name: Brannoc Sparkwell
title: Smith
greeting: Big Bran's forge! Mind the sparks. And the moths. Mostly the moths.
barks: This is Hammer Gerald. Say hello to Gerald.
Upgrading never breaks a thing. Not on my anvil.
Is that a moth? Tell me that's not a moth.
Bring me Soot Dust. I'll bring the shine.
Hot iron, warm heart. That's the rule.
Hammer Gerald's cousin is Hammer Gertrude. She's for fancy work.
Every sword remembers the hand that made it. Mine remember hugs.

name: Nettle Pim
title: Alchemist
greeting: Oh! A customer! Hold on, I need to climb onto my stool.
barks: Red potion: feel better. Blue potion: don't drink the blue one.
Ah— ah— ACHOO! Sorry. Glitter. It happens.
Bone Meal makes lovely potions. Don't ask how.
Tall people always knock over my shelves.
Fizzing means it's working! Or broken. Usually working.
Drink a potion when your light gets low. Easy!

name: Madame Glimmerwick
title: Jeweler
greeting: Welcome, darling! Have you seen my blue ring? …Oh. Found it.
barks: Forty rings, and not one is the right one.
A gem in a socket is a little star in your pocket.
Candle Ruby for courage. Frost Sapphire for calm.
I polish my rings so often they polish me back.
Never trust a Magpie Imp near a jewellery box.
Darling, that amulet is SO you.

name: Grandpa Knurl
title: Runecarver
greeting: Hm? Oh, hello. Mind the table. I carved a rune on it.
barks: This spoon has a rune for 'soup'. Very useful.
Runes are just words that remember to work.
Carve slow. The wood tells you where.
I once carved 'brave' on my boots. Didn't help.
When you reach Rimehall, find Master Quillon. He carves ice!
My chair says 'sit'. So I do.

name: Pocket Polly
title: Trader
greeting: Buying? Selling? Let me check my pockets. All of them.
barks: Pocket forty-two… no, that's a frog. Sorry, frog.
I've got a pocket for everything. Finding it is extra.
I buy anything shiny. Except Magpie Imps. They buy back.
Fair prices, honest pockets!
One of my pockets hums at night. I don't check that one.
Something you don't need? I'll give you coins for it.

name: Humphrey
title: Stash Keeper
greeting: Your… things… are… safe. One. One. Two. Two.
barks: Nothing… lost… in… a hundred… years.
Slow… and… safe.
Your stash… follows you… to every… town. Clever… that.
I counted… your socks. Twice. All there.
Don't… rush. I never… do.
Shell… is also… a stash.

name: Hattie Hayloft
title: Stablemaster
greeting: Hello! Puddle says hello too. Don't you, Puddle? She does.
barks: Puddle says you look like a good rider.
A newt on the path is faster than two boots in the mud.
If something bonks you, you'll hop off. Newts are shy.
Squelch says he wants a snack. Squelch always wants a snack.
Riding's quicker in the zones and in town, dear.
Pat them on the nose. Gently. They like that.

name: Wren Whistleby
title: Pet Keeper
greeting: State your pet's name and favourite snack, please.
barks: Pets pick up loot for you. Very professional.
Pets get stronger when you go adventuring together.
Some pets dig up treasure. I'm not jealous. I'm a bit jealous.
Every pet deserves a good name. Not 'Pet'.
I've got a list of all the pets in Lumenholm. It's long.
Pets don't fight. They help. That's different.

name: Mother Mabble
title: Innkeeper
greeting: Sit down, pet. Soup's hot. Everything's better after soup.
barks: Rest here and the Homeward Wick will bring you back.
Resting makes your light glow brighter. That's just true.
Soup of the day: soup.
The roof leaks, but only on people who complain.
You look tired. Tired is allowed.
A warm bed, a warm bowl, a warm light. That's home.

name: Warden Hollis Reed
title: Warden
greeting: Wickbearer! Thank the light. I mean it. I really need help.
barks: The helmet was my father's. I'll grow into it.
Stay in your light and you'll be alright.
The Rattlebones aren't bad. They're just lost.
Every lamp we tie down is one more we keep.
When you're tired, come back. The bog will wait.
I heard a bell under the water last night.
One step at a time. That's how you cross a bog.

name: Grandmother Purl
title: Storyteller
greeting: Come sit, little light. Pass me that yarn and I'll tell you a tale.
barks: Knit one, purl one, tell one story.
This scarf is for everyone in the village. It's a long scarf.
Once, the sky had a lantern, and nobody thought to thank it.
The Grey Guest knocked on my door once. I gave him tea.
My granddaughter sews dolls that talk back. Takes after me.
Every story is a light you can carry in your head.
Lost your way? Follow the lamps. They float toward home.

name: Flicker
title: Waypoint Keeper
greeting: Hi! I'm Flicker! I'm not scared at all! *flicker*
barks: Touch a waypoint once and you can come back any time!
Travelling to town is free. The rest costs a little gold.
I've been to every waypoint. *flicker* Okay, two.
Wisps like me show the way. Not like the bad wisps. We're nice.
Tap the map to go places!
I'm the brightest wisp in Wickmire! *flicker flicker*

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
greeting: The Lamplight Hollow Bounty Board. Pinned notes flap in the bog breeze.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.

name: The Masked Peddler
title: Curio Cart
greeting: Hushmarks only, dearie. No coins, no crowns, no tricks. What you see is what you get... eventually.
barks: Every mystery is honest. The rarity shows the moment you pay.
Hushmarks come from the quiet places. Keep looking.
I never tell where I'll park next. Always the same town, though. Funny, that.
No refunds. No regrets. Only surprises.

name: Tamsin Knotwood
title: Smith
greeting: Sorry, tree. Oh! Hello. Sorry. I talk to trees.
barks: Sorry, log. This won't hurt a bit.
Wood remembers where it grew. Be kind to it.
Axe handles, bow staves, and one very nice spoon.
Upgrading here is just like Big Bran's. Only woodier.
The birches told me a secret about you. I didn't listen.
Every nick in a blade is a story.

name: Professor Fennimore Puffcap
title: Alchemist
greeting: Ah, a student! Welcome to the finest laboratory in any tree. *puff*
barks: Alchemy: turning 'oops' into 'ooh!'
Potions, elixirs, transmutes. All the -ions and -irs.
Don't startle me. *puff* See? Sparkles everywhere.
Two small things can become one useful thing. That's the trick.
Mushrooms are excellent listeners. Terrible at maths.
Let me show you the station. Just one little brew to start.
Elixirs last a while. Enjoy the glow.

name: Cress Dewdrop
title: Jeweler
greeting: Hello! Careful where you step. That's a jewel. Was a jewel.
barks: My best gem evaporated this morning. Again.
Moss Emeralds don't evaporate. That's why I like them.
Put a gem in a socket and it helps you forever.
Dew is just tiny water that dreams of being a gem.
Pretty things are best shared.
I found a gem in an owl's nest. The owl found me.

name: Hob Mossbeard
title: Runecarver
greeting: Mm. Welcome. Don't mind the beard. It's thriving.
barks: A rune on an acorn grows into a rune on a tree.
Something is living in my beard. We have an agreement.
Slow carving, quick magic.
My brother Knurl carves spoons. Spoons. Honestly.
The forest has its own runes. You just have to read bark.
Beard's getting long. It's got a mushroom now.

name: Mister Quibble
title: Trader
greeting: Whooo's buying? What has pockets but no coat? My shop!
barks: What's cheaper than cheap? A good deal!
I sell by day, I sell by night. Well. Mostly night.
Riddle me this: what's worth more once you use it?
Everything here is lightly loved.
Hoo-hoo! Sharp eyes, fair prices.
The answer to every riddle is 'buy one'. Just kidding.

name: Nutsy
title: Stash Keeper
greeting: Stash? STASH! Yes! I buried it! It's… somewhere! Good spot!
barks: I remember EVERY hiding place! …Most of them!
Your stash is the same in every town. Magic! Or tunnels.
I found an acorn from last year! Snack!
Buried treasure is the best treasure!
Don't worry. I've never lost anything. Recently.
Chitter chitter! That means 'safe' in squirrel.

name: Ferris Longstride
title: Stablemaster
greeting: *whistles* That means welcome. Want a deer?
barks: *whistles* That means yes.
Moss-deer never trip on roots. Never.
Get bumped and you'll hop down. Deer don't like fights.
This one's Fern. That one's also Fern. They like it.
Faster through the woods, faster through the town.
*long whistle* That means 'have a good ride'.

name: Juniper Fitch
title: Pet Keeper
greeting: Hello! Shh. Owlet nap time. Hoo. Sorry. Hello.
barks: Owlets sleep all day. Best job ever.
Hoo? Oh, sorry. What did you ask?
A pet finds shiny things you'd walk right past.
Level up your pet by adventuring together.
Wren from Lamplight Hollow writes me pet letters!
This owlet is called Doughnut. Don't ask why. She knows why.

name: Bramble Hartwell
title: Innkeeper
greeting: Welcome to The Hollow Knot! Beds are hammocks. Don't fall out.
barks: All our beds rock. Literally.
Bind your Homeward Wick here and you'll always get home.
Nap in a hammock and the forest sings you to sleep.
A rest is not a stop. It's a refill.
Tea? It's acorn tea. It's a bit crunchy.
Nobody's fallen out of a hammock this week. Big week.

name: Ranger Sorrel Vane
title: Ranger
greeting: AH! Oh. It's you. Sorry. The trees keep whispering.
barks: Did you hear that? That was a whisper. Probably about me.
Brave doesn't mean not scared. I'm very brave.
The Owlcrows see everything. Even when you sneak.
The shadows are missing. Look at your feet in the woods.
Twiglings pretend to be sticks. Poke every stick.
When it gets too much, take a break. I do. Often.

name: Old Hoot
title: Storyteller
greeting: Who comes to Old Hoot? And why? And who's asking?
barks: What is a shadow, if not light's best friend?
Did you know my apprentice pulls stars from the sky? Did I teach her that?
Why do trees whisper? What would you say, if you were a tree?
Who blew out the Lantern? Why would anyone?
Is the dark empty, or just waiting?
What's heavier: a lantern, or carrying it alone?

name: Lumen the Glowworm
title: Waypoint Keeper
greeting: Hello, hello, a traveller's here! Pick a place, and I'll steer.
barks: Touch a stone, it's yours to keep. Travel there before you sleep!
To town is free, the rest a coin. Where would you like to join?
I glow, I glow, from tail to head. The map is where you go instead.
Waypoints shine like little stars. Near or far, the path is ours.
Lost in the wood? Don't make a fuss. Come back here and ride with us.
A rhyme a day keeps the Hush away!

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
greeting: The Owlstead Bounty Board. Notes are pinned with acorns.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.

name: The Masked Peddler
title: Curio Cart
greeting: Hushmarks only, dearie. No coins, no crowns, no tricks. What you see is what you get... eventually.
barks: Every mystery is honest. The rarity shows the moment you pay.
Hushmarks come from the quiet places. Keep looking.
I never tell where I'll park next. Always the same town, though. Funny, that.
No refunds. No regrets. Only surprises.

name: Dorra Anvilsong
title: Smith
greeting: WELCOME TO THE FORGE! SORRY! IT'S A LOUD FORGE!
barks: CLANG! That's the chorus.
My nephew's got a bell for a hammer. Runs in the family!
SING while you hammer and the metal sits up straight!
Upgrades never fail here. Loud AND reliable.
Mines are quiet now. Too quiet. Needs more CLANG.
If you see my nephew, tell him to wear a scarf.

name: Fizzwick Drabb
title: Alchemist
greeting: Welcome! Don't mind the smoke. Or the eyebrows. They're coming back.
barks: Pop! That was supposed to happen. Mostly.
Salt makes everything better. Even potions. Especially potions.
Professor Puffcap taught me. He still sends me spore letters.
Safety goggles! I should wear those.
My eyebrows grow back faster every time. Science!
This one's a transmute. Tiny stuff into better stuff.

name: Opaline Facet
title: Jeweler
greeting: Oh, you're a bit dusty. Hold still. *polish polish* There.
barks: Every gem was once a bit of mountain dreaming.
Sockets, gems, rings, amulets. I do all of it. Shinily.
Let me show you the station. One gem, one socket, one smile.
Crystal Spiders are made of gems. Don't polish them.
Dust is just shine that's shy.
*polish* Sorry. Habit. Your elbow was dull.

name: Chisel
title: Runecarver
greeting: Hello. Rune. Please.
barks: Carve. Tap. Glow.
Stone. Friend.
Rune. Strong.
Me. Small. Rock. Big.
Quillon. Ice. Teacher. Far.
You. Nice.

name: Gus Two-Carts
title: Trader
greeting: Left cart buys, right cart sells. Or the other way. Let's find out!
barks: Two carts, twice the bargains!
Found it in the mines! It's basically new. Basically.
If one cart rolls away, the prices roll with it.
Sell me what you don't need. I'll find it a good home.
Best prices under the mountain! Only prices under the mountain!
Ever seen a cart with teeth? Don't buy that one.

name: Pickett
title: Stash Keeper
greeting: Stash cart's ready! Wait. Where's cart six? Oh, there it goes.
barks: Don't worry. The carts always come back. The track's a circle.
Your stash is safe in every town. Even on wheels.
Cart six is the adventurous one.
I oil the wheels every morning. Squeak-free stashing!
Everything you put in, stays in. Rails' honour.
Here comes cart six! Told you.

name: Mags Rattlebridle
title: Stablemaster
greeting: Need to get somewhere? I know a shortcut. I always know a shortcut.
barks: Rock-ponies never get tired. They get sleepy. It's different.
Shortest way to the lift? Left, left, down, whee.
Get bonked and you're off the pony. Rules of the rocks.
This is Gravel. That's Pebble. That's Other Gravel.
Riding's faster. Walking's scenic. Your choice.
Shortcut to happiness? Pat a pony.

name: Tuppence
title: Pet Keeper
greeting: This is Dimple. She's a glow-mole. She likes you. I can tell.
barks: Dimple digs up treasure! Some pets do that!
I'm not scared of anything. Except baths.
Pets help find materials. Dimple found a whole sandwich.
Echo bats make great pets. They copy your giggles.
Pets get better the more you explore together.
Dimple says hi. That was the hi. The wiggle.

name: Barnaby Ballast
title: Innkeeper
greeting: Welcome to The Deep Breath! HA HA! Sorry. Lift's fine. Probably.
barks: We pump fresh air all the way down! Breathe deep!
Bind your Homeward Wick here. HA! Home is where the laugh is!
Rest up. A tired miner digs holes in the wrong places.
My laugh broke a crystal once. Now it's two crystals. Bonus!
Stew's got salt. Everything's got salt. It's a salt mine.
Stay as long as you like, friend.

name: Foreman Hilda Pickwell
title: Foreman
greeting: Wickbearer. Good. I have a list of jobs. And a list of reasons. One's blank.
barks: Why do we dig? It's on my list. The list is blank.
Diglings were my crew. They're not bad. They forgot.
Lamp ghosts wander the tunnels looking for their miners.
Keep your light up in the shafts. It's dark down there.
When your pack's full, come up. The mine's not going anywhere.
There used to be a song. I can almost hear it.

name: Echo Annie
title: Storyteller
greeting: Sit down, dearie, and I'll tell you a story. Story.
barks: The mountain used to sing to us. Us.
Every tunnel holds a memory. Memory.
When the lamps went out, the song went too. Too.
The Great Echo copies everything. Everything.
I've always done this. Nobody knows why. Why.
A quiet mountain is a lonely mountain. Mountain.

name: Lou Lever
title: Waypoint Keeper
greeting: Going up! Going down! Going sideways, if you like the map!
barks: Floor one: waypoints. Floor two: also waypoints.
Mind the gap. There's no gap. Mind it anyway.
Town trips are free. Other stops cost a coin.
Ding! That's my lift bell. Not your nephew, Dorra.
Next stop: wherever you tap.
Doors closing! There are no doors.

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
greeting: The Clinkerton Bounty Board. Chalk on a slate. Someone drew a pickaxe with a face.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.

name: The Masked Peddler
title: Curio Cart
greeting: Hushmarks only, dearie. No coins, no crowns, no tricks. What you see is what you get... eventually.
barks: Every mystery is honest. The rarity shows the moment you pay.
Hushmarks come from the quiet places. Keep looking.
I never tell where I'll park next. Always the same town, though. Funny, that.
No refunds. No regrets. Only surprises.

name: Corporal Tinwhistle
title: Smith
greeting: Attention! *salute* A visitor! *salute* To the anvil! *salute*
barks: *salute* That was for the hammer.
Polished boots, polished blade, polished upgrade!
I was a soldier once. Now I'm a smith. Still saluting.
Upgrades succeed on first try. That is an order!
My old regiment froze in the hall. I'll wait for them.
Left, right, left, CLANG.

name: Cook Dumplina
title: Alchemist
greeting: Hungry? Hurt? Same thing, pet. Have a soup.
barks: Healing soup. Strength soup. Soup soup.
Every potion's a soup if you believe.
Mother Mabble in Wickmire? My cousin! Soup runs in families.
Don't drink it too hot. Or do. It's a warming soup.
The frozen guests haven't eaten in a year. I've kept the pot on.
Carrots help you see in the dark. Very useful now.

name: Lady Facetta Frostglass
title: Jeweler
greeting: Good evening. One does jewels here. Properly. *tiny giggle*
barks: A lady never giggles. *giggle* Oh dear.
The crown jewels are frozen. I polish them anyway.
Frost Sapphire. Terribly elegant. Terribly cold.
Please do not lick the ice. One has seen it happen.
A ring for the brave, a gem for the kind.
One's cousin Glimmerwick has too many rings. One has just enough.

name: Master Quillon Rimecarve
title: Runecarver
greeting: Close the door. Warmth is getting in. Ugh. Kitchens.
barks: Ice holds a rune perfectly. Until it melts. Hence: no kettles.
Enchant, reroll, refine. Precision is kindness.
Let me show you the station. One rune. Clean lines.
Chisel sends me letters. One word each. I treasure them.
Knurl carves spoons. I carve spoons too. In ice. Better spoons.
Someone put the kettle on again. *sigh*

name: Crumbsworth
title: Trader
greeting: Welcome to Crumbsworth's Teacup Emporium! Mind the handle.
barks: Small shop. Big deals.
I accept gold, crumbs, and particularly good cheese.
Everything here fits in a teacup. Except that sword. Somehow.
The mirror butlers kept trying to serve my shop.
Sell anything! I'll squeeze it in. Squeak.
Crumbsworth's rule: never trade with a cat.

name: Mister Ledger
title: Stash Keeper
greeting: Good evening. Your belongings are catalogued. Page nine thousand.
barks: Item received. Item noted. Item cherished.
I did not freeze because I was busy writing. Recommend it.
Your stash is shared in every town. I have the records.
One sock, blue, slightly heroic. Noted.
The mirror butlers were my colleagues. They serve tea wrongly now.
Everything in order. As always.

name: Noll Frostmane
title: Stablemaster
greeting: Wrap up warm! Then pick a hare. Then wrap up warmer.
barks: Snow-hares hop over drifts. Boots don't.
Scarf? Scarf. Put on a scarf.
Take a bump and you'll tumble off. Hares are gentle souls.
This one's Flurry. That's Sleet. That's Mister Fluffington.
Faster in the gardens, faster in the halls.
Did you wrap up warm? Just checking.

name: Princess Pip
title: Pet Keeper
greeting: I'm Princess Pip and I'm in charge of the royal pets. Bow. Or wave. Waving's fine.
barks: The royal corgi-hare is called Sir Wobble. Salute him.
Pets need love, snacks, and adventures. In that order.
Kit taught me to climb roofs. Don't tell Nan Kettleby.
My dad forgot my name. I'll help him remember.
A pet can find treasure you'd never see.
I'm not sad. I'm just busy being brave.

name: Nan Kettleby
title: Innkeeper
greeting: Kettle's on, dearie. It's always on. Sit by the warm.
barks: Tea for the cold, tea for the sad, tea for the tired.
Bind your Homeward Wick here. The kettle will be on.
A cup and a sit-down. Nothing's so bad after that.
Rest is how heroes get heroic.
Master Quillon hates my kettle. I make him tea anyway.
That child Pip is climbing the roof again, isn't she.

name: Chancellor Pellinore Snowdrop
title: Chancellor
greeting: Ah. You're on my list. My list of people who might help. It's short.
barks: List of lists: item one, this list.
Half my moustache thawed. The other half is thinking about it.
His Majesty grows colder the less he remembers.
Letters of his name are scattered in the halls. Find them.
Mind the mirrors. Reflections here are running late.
Do take breaks. It's on my list. Near the top.

name: Tumblewit the Jester
title: Storyteller
greeting: A tale, a tale! Shall it be sad? It'll be funny. Or the other way.
barks: Once there was a king with the warmest hall. …That's the sad part.
Why did the snowman cry? He was having a meltdown.
Jingle jingle. My bells are frozen. So they just go 'jin'.
The toast was never finished. That's the saddest joke I know.
Laughing keeps you warm. Try it! Ha. See?
Every king needs a fool. Every fool needs a friend.

name: Tick
title: Waypoint Keeper
greeting: Hello. Tick. Tick. Where would you like to go?
barks: Tick. Tick. Calculating route. Tick. Done.
Waypoints remember you once you've touched them.
Town is free. Other places: small fee. Tick.
I was built to keep time. Now I keep places.
Wind me up if I slow down. Please.
Tick tock. That's my happy noise.

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
greeting: The Kettlekeep Bounty Board. Notes written in very neat handwriting. Mister Ledger's, probably.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.

name: The Masked Peddler
title: Curio Cart
greeting: Hushmarks only, dearie. No coins, no crowns, no tricks. What you see is what you get... eventually.
barks: Every mystery is honest. The rarity shows the moment you pay.
Hushmarks come from the quiet places. Keep looking.
I never tell where I'll park next. Always the same town, though. Funny, that.
No refunds. No regrets. Only surprises.

name: Mae Coalbright
title: Smith
greeting: Come in, come in. I'm still just learning, mind. Only seventy years.
barks: I made your lantern's great-great-grandmother.
Upgrades never fail. After seventy years, I should hope not.
Every lantern needs a good cap, a good glass and a good friend.
Big Bran was my apprentice! He's still scared of moths.
Out here, the only colour is the one we make.
A good hammer is a patient hammer.

name: Mother Simmer
title: Cauldron Keeper
greeting: Hello, dearie. The Cauldron says hello too. *burble*
barks: Put anything in. See what comes out. The Cauldron never breaks a thing.
*burble* She likes you. She only burbles twice for friends.
Secret recipes are just surprises with instructions.
Every discovery goes in your journal. Keep it handy.
Let me show you. One little mix to start.
Stir left for luck. Stir right for soup.

name: Twinkle
title: Jeweler
greeting: I'm a star! A real one! I'm just… compact.
barks: Don't call me small. Call me concentrated.
I fell from the sky the night the Lantern went out.
Gems are just stars that decided to stay.
I can socket anything. With help. From a stool.
Stargazers keep trying to throw me. Please don't.
Big twinkle or small twinkle, still a twinkle.

name: Vesper Inkwell
title: Runecarver
greeting: Don't blink. There. You blinked. Let me write it again.
barks: A rune of light lasts as long as someone reads it.
Ink, light, patience.
Quillon carves ice. I write light. We argue by letter.
Every rune is a small promise.
Read slowly. The words like it.
*writes* *you blink* *sigh* Again.

name: Nib
title: Trader
greeting: Shinies! Lovely shinies! All borrowed! Permanently! Legally!
barks: I used to be a Magpie Imp. Now I'm a magpie businessman.
You caught my cousin in Wickmire. She says hi. Grumpily.
Fair prices! Mostly fair! Fairly fair!
Ooh, is that shiny? Can I— no. No. I'm reformed.
The Hoard? Never heard of it. What Hoard.
Sell me your shinies and I'll give them a good home.

name: Keeper Stillwater
title: Stash Keeper
greeting: Welcome. Take your time. There is always time.
barks: Nothing here is in a hurry. Least of all me.
Your stash is safe. Breathe in. Breathe out.
Hurrying makes you drop things. So I never hurry.
Everything you keep, I keep.
The Hush is quiet. So am I. We're different, though.
Rest is not wasted time.

name: Captain Loft
title: Stablemaster
greeting: Goggles on! Moths ready! Captain Loft, at your service!
barks: Great moths fly toward light. That's you. Handy!
Bump into trouble and you'll hop off. Moths hate fuss.
Goggles indoors? Can't be too careful.
This is Dusty. She's very soft and very fast.
Faster on the islands. Faster through the Landing.
Big Bran's scared of my moths. Tell him they're friendly!

name: Tansy Glow
title: Pet Keeper
greeting: Hello! These are my fireflies. They're only visiting.
barks: Every night I open the jars. Every morning they come back.
Pets are friends who choose to stay.
Mystery eggs hatch into all sorts. Carry one around!
A pet at full level is a proper best friend.
Juniper sends me owl feathers. I send her fireflies.
Light is better shared. Even firefly light.

name: Aunt Lumi
title: Innkeeper
greeting: Come in from the grey, love. There's a light in every window for you.
barks: A lit window means someone's waiting for you.
Bind your Homeward Wick here. There'll always be a light on.
The Well is cold. The Last Lamp isn't.
Resting is part of carrying the light. Ada forgets that.
Sit. Warm up. The Well will still be there.
Nobody's too tired to be welcome.

name: Ada Brightly
title: Master Wickwright
greeting: A Wickbearer. At last. Sit, sit. I'll stand. I always stand.
barks: A light shared is not a light lost. That's the Guild's rule.
I knew the Grey Guest once. Before he was grey.
Ninety-nine chairs in our hall. Only one is ever sat in.
Down is up in the Well. Walk carefully.
I should rest more. Don't tell Aunt Lumi I said that.
Carry the light. Share it when you can. Rest when you need to.

name: The Moth Choir
title: Storyteller
greeting: *tiny chorus* Hellooo, little light! Lean in, lean in!
barks: *sing* Once was a spark that wandered alone…
*sing* The Hush said nothing, and so it shone…
*hum* Where moths gather, secrets hide.
*sing* One keeper climbed, and nobody came…
*giggle* You're very bright. We like bright.
*sing* Carry the light, and then pass it on…

name: Nobody
title: Waypoint Keeper
greeting: …  (Nobody tips its hat. The map glows.)
barks: …  (Nobody points at the map. Politely.)
…  (Nobody waves. You think it's a wave.)
…  (A tiny, happy silence.)
…  (Nobody straightens its hat. It is very proud of the hat.)
…  (Nobody seems to be saying: town trips are free.)
…  (Somewhere, very quietly, a hum.)

name: Bounty Board
title: Bounty Board
greeting: The Lastlight Bounty Board. The notes glow faintly. Nobody pinned them. They were just there.
barks: Bounties wait here. They never go stale.
Finished bounties bank up. Come back whenever you like.
New notes appear as you adventure.
A bounty a day? A bounty a month? Up to you.
Someone has drawn a smiley face on this note.
Unfinished bounties don't mind waiting.

name: Pell
title: Retired Keeper
greeting: Oh, hello. Sit down, if you like. I've learned that sitting down is allowed.
barks: I trim the wick on Sundays. Only Sundays.
Thank you for asking me in. Everyone did, in the end.
Ada makes me rest. I make Ada rest. It's a system.
The Hush isn't bad. It's just night that forgot about morning.
Rest when you need to. I wish I had.
Tolly rings his bell when I visit. I like that very much.
Aldric saved me a seat. I sit in it every week.

name: The Masked Peddler
title: Curio Cart
greeting: Hushmarks only, dearie. No coins, no crowns, no tricks. What you see is what you get... eventually.
barks: Every mystery is honest. The rarity shows the moment you pay.
Hushmarks come from the quiet places. Keep looking.
I never tell where I'll park next. Always the same town, though. Funny, that.
No refunds. No regrets. Only surprises.
